nodes.rationale: Port 3000 is published directly so any header can be forged; visitors share the web app's address and per-IP limits. Production runs on k3s behind Cloudflare.

nodes.label: bookings.sweep worker expiry
nodes.rationale: Housekeeping, never correctness; booking transactions expire stale pendings themselves.

nodes.label: app.clients.find_or_create
nodes.rationale: Refreshes client copy only when booker is authenticated as that address (refresh=True); otherwise fills blanks only.

nodes.label: member_slots (single bookability validator)
nodes.rationale: Write paths re-derive starts through member_slots, never a second validator, because two implementations drift; merchant override (ZIF-57) is the deliberate exception.

nodes.label: Alembic single-head migration chain
nodes.rationale: Migration numbers are identifiers not order; alembic heads must print one line; use merge revisions rather than editing merged migrations.

nodes.label: booking_holds (guest held times)
nodes.rationale: ZIF-117: 15-minute hold while a guest confirms the emailed link; no EXCLUDE since live needs now(), so lock 51 plus re-derivation keeps holds apart.

nodes.label: clients (business-owned client records)
nodes.rationale: A business's own copy of name/contact (ZIF-99); no FK to users because FK checks bypass RLS and would leak account existence.

nodes.label: ex_bookings_worker_overlap exclusion constraint
nodes.rationale: The database, not any code path, makes worker bookings exclusive so a forgotten route guard cannot double-book.

nodes.label: API lock_timeout 5s (503 busy)
nodes.rationale: ZIF-114: lock waits capped at 5s; never hold the tenant lock across an outbound call.

nodes.label: SECURITY DEFINER credential functions
nodes.rationale: Passwords and tokens live in tables the app role cannot access; functions set a safe search_path with pg_temp last and are revoked from PUBLIC.

nodes.label: users global table
nodes.rationale: RLS enabled but not forced; app role sees users only via membership in current tenant and can never update or delete.

nodes.label: Booking evidence snapshot
nodes.rationale: Service, price, policy text etc. are snapshotted on the booking; client personal data is not, so ZIF-58 erasure keeps one tombstone.

nodes.label: Expand-then-contract migrations
nodes.rationale: Old and new app versions run against the same database during a deploy, so a migration must never break the running version.

nodes.label: Tenant advisory lock 51
nodes.rationale: EXCLUDE has no speculative-insertion path; about 9% of concurrent losers deadlocked, so every booking writer takes pg_advisory_xact_lock(51, tenant) first.

nodes.label: keep_an_owner trigger
nodes.rationale: Trigger locks tenants; endpoints never lock tenants to avoid opposite lock order deadlocks.

nodes.label: Composite tenant foreign keys
nodes.rationale: Foreign key checks bypass RLS, so references pair tenant_id; ON DELETE SET NULL (x_id) avoids nulling tenant_id.

nodes.label: Postgres row-level security tenant isolation
nodes.rationale: Isolation enforced by the database rather than remembering WHERE tenant_id filters.

nodes.label: jobs table (app/jobs.py)
nodes.rationale: No broker or scheduler; enqueue in same transaction; dedupe key runs once; handlers must be idempotent.

nodes.label: app.logs.configure() structured logging
nodes.rationale: JSON lines on stdout; ids only, never personal data; log error class not message.

nodes.label: tenant_context(tenant_id)
nodes.rationale: A query without a tenant raises instead of returning nothing.

nodes.label: app.tracing hand-written spans
nodes.rationale: No contrib instrumentation since it records raw URLs and SQL errors that can quote personal data; attributes allowlisted.

nodes.label: email.booking job (ZIF-53)
nodes.rationale: Gated by booking status at send time and enqueued in the same transaction as the status change.

nodes.label: Vendor-neutral observability over OTLP
nodes.rationale: Backend choice lives in OpenTelemetry Collector config, never app code; no vendor agent in the repo.

nodes.norm_label: no build-time next_public_* env vars check
nodes.rationale: NEXT_PUBLIC_* is baked in at build time; configuration must be read at runtime so one image serves every environment.

nodes.rationale: Rate limits and audit events key on visitor address; app code reads request.client.host only.
